clear_game_settings_tooltip: Deletes the game settings (SPT/user/sptsettings folder). Graphics, audio, controls and other preferences go back to default. Does not affect your profile or your progress.
clean_temp_files_tooltip: Removes the temporary files the game generates (cache). Frees up space and helps fix crashes or stuck loading screens. Safe: no progress is deleted.
copy_logs_tooltip: Copies the log files (launcher, server, BepInEx and your profile) to the clipboard, ready to paste when asking for support.
use_performance_configs_description: Applies the server's performance config pack on the next file check. Configs you customized are preserved. When turned off, the next check restores the server's default configs that haven't changed since the last sync, and the rest stay as they are.
dev_mode_description: Developer mode (for mod creators): protects your local files and builds from the sync, does not revert them, and skips the automatic mod/config check on login. Regular players don't need to turn it on.
use_local_server_tooltip: Points the launcher at the LOCAL server (127.0.0.1:6969) instead of the URL above, saving the previous URL. When you uncheck it, it goes back to the URL you had. Requires reconnecting.
use_local_server_description: Check → uses 127.0.0.1 and saves the current URL. Uncheck → restores the saved URL.
block_launcher_update_tooltip: Stops the launcher from downloading and installing a newer version of ITSELF (the TRL.Launcher.exe), even if one exists on the server. Does NOT affect the mod/config sync. Active only while Dev Mode is on. When you turn Dev Mode off, this block is reset.
block_launcher_update_description: Blocks only the launcher's own auto-update (the .exe). Doesn't touch the mod/config sync. Reset when you turn Dev Mode off.
homolog_mode_tooltip: Points the TarkovRedLine mod routes at the staging mod (TarkovRedLine.Server.Homolog) on the same server. SPT core routes don't change. Requires reconnecting.
homolog_mode_description: Only for testing against staging. Leave it OFF for production.
account_wipe_tooltip: Wipes the profile's progress; the account itself stays
account_delete_tooltip: Permanently removes the account and profile from the server
account_wipe_delete_explainer: Wipe resets your progress and keeps the account. Delete removes the account from the server for good.
